description: This file implements the retention policy store for Mattermost, including CRUD operations, policy management, and cleanup of orphaned rows related to retention policies in the database.

classes.name: SqlRetentionPolicyStore
classes.description: Struct implementing retention policy storage operations, including create, read, update, delete, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Creates a new retention policy with associated channels and teams, returning the created policy with counts.

methods.name: checkTeamsExist
methods.description: Verifies that the specified team IDs exist in the database.

methods.name: checkChannelsExist
methods.description: Verifies that the specified channel IDs exist in the database.

methods.name: buildInsertRetentionPoliciesChannelsQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query to insert multiple channel associations for a policy.

methods.name: buildInsertRetentionPoliciesTeamsQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query to insert multiple team associations for a policy.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Updates an existing retention policy, including its attributes and associated channels and teams, returning the updated policy with counts.

methods.name: buildGetPolicyQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query to retrieve a specific retention policy with counts.

methods.name: buildGetPoliciesQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query to retrieve multiple retention policies with counts, optionally filtered by ID.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific retention policy with counts by ID.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all retention policies with counts, with pagination.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Returns total number of retention policies.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a retention policy by ID.

methods.name: GetChannels
methods.description: Retrieves channels associated with a retention policy.

methods.name: GetChannelsCount
methods.description: Counts channels associated with a retention policy.

methods.name: AddChannels
methods.description: Associates channels with a retention policy.

methods.name: RemoveChannels
methods.description: Removes channel associations from a retention policy.

methods.name: GetTeams
methods.description: Retrieves teams associated with a retention policy.

methods.name: GetTeamsCount
methods.description: Counts teams associated with a retention policy.

methods.name: AddTeams
methods.description: Associates teams with a retention policy.

methods.name: RemoveTeams
methods.description: Removes team associations from a retention policy.

methods.name: DeleteOrphanedRows
methods.description: Removes orphaned entries in retention policy channel and team associations where referenced channels or teams no longer exist.

methods.name: GetTeamPoliciesForUser
methods.description: Retrieves retention policies applicable to a user based on team memberships.

methods.name: GetTeamPoliciesCountForUser
methods.description: Counts retention policies applicable to a user based on team memberships.

methods.name: GetChannelPoliciesForUser
methods.description: Retrieves retention policies applicable to a user based on channel memberships.

methods.name: GetChannelPoliciesCountForUser
methods.description: Counts retention policies applicable to a user based on channel memberships.

methods.name: GetIdsForDeletionByTableName
methods.description: Retrieves retention IDs marked for deletion for a specific table.

methods.name: genericPermanentDeleteBatchForRetentionPolicies
methods.description: Performs batch deletion of records under retention policies, considering granular and global policies.
